title: Website exception snippet input (v0.5, D36)
description: Input of the exception snippet a possible false positive (MVP-22 listFalsePositiveHints) offers for rules.d, used by the website-exception vectors: the website of the hint (id and hosts as listWebsites returns them), the rule, the page (exact path or path template with {name} segments), the optional matched variable and a fresh local rule id. The result is {scope, snippet} (contract/websites.ExceptionSnippet): scope website with a Host condition heading a chain, or scope gateway for a website without hosts. The text is fixed byte for byte. Never applied by schild (D32).

hosts.description: Normalised hosts (contract/websites Website.hosts): LDH labels or * labels, IPv4, or an IPv6 literal without brackets.

path.description: Starts with /; no quote, backslash, space or control character; braces only as {name} segments (checked by the renderer).
